question: Are barefoot shoes good for your feet?

say: Barefoot shoes: shoes designed to feel like no shoes.
Each foot has twenty-six bones and three arches.
Small muscles inside the foot help hold them up.
Like any muscle, they get stronger when they work.
In one trial, eight weeks of walking in flat, flexible shoes made foot muscles forty-one percent stronger.
Foot exercises did even more: fifty-eight percent.
In another, runners given eight weeks of foot training got fewer running injuries over the next year.
When runners moved to toe shoes over ten weeks, ten of nineteen showed bone stress on MRI.
The trial that worked built up slowly: two and a half thousand steps a day, then five thousand, then seven.
Feet painful, stiff, weak or numb?
See a doctor, not a shoe shop.
